text:
anna: Quick thread  planning relnotes + changelog copy for next deploy. main asks: (1) localize short blurb for EU customers, (2) confirm snippet sync across py/js/go, (3) validate staging preview link.
pablo: I can do localization QA for fr,de,es. will need final english strings by 11:00 PT.
kevin: working on sample updates. i'll sweep py/js/go for: sdk version, env var pattern, and renamed fields. planning PRs: #3801 (py), #3802 (js), #3803 (go).
mei: FYI security flagged one more example with a real-looking telemetry id in examples/observability.md. i'll open scrub PR.
docs-bot: PR #3804 opened by mei  scrub telemetry ids and replace with env var pattern.
lucy: for staging preview, use the docs-staging URL: https://docs-staging.redwood.ai/releases/2026-03-preview. please check anchors and code blocks render correctly (especially fenced python and backticks).
anna: add to checklist: *no hardcoded keys*, *SDK version normalized to comment header*, *migration links present*, *localization strings in i18n folder*.
pablo: for translations, i need the short bullets and the known-issue paragraph. propose english text: "Breaking change: Embeddings streaming API renamed from stream_embeddings -> embeddings.stream. See migration guide for snippets and timeline." and known-issue: "Some quantized models may truncate long prompts when prefix caching is enabled. Workaround: disable prefix caching or pin to non-quantized model."
kevin: thumbs up. i'll update snippets and include a short migration file: docs/releases/migrate-2026-03.md with py/js/go examples. include a one-liner at top: "Examples target SDK v0.14 / v1.2"
mei: scrub PR #3804 merged. removed telemetry ids.
docs-bot: PR #3801 opened by kevin  python snippet updates.
anna: staging preview link updated with PR list: #3801, #3802, #3803, #3804. translators: i'll ping when english strings are final.
lucy: quick rendering check: tool calling examples show a tiny CSS issue around inline code on mobile. filed internal ticket #517. will add note to relnotes: "Docs: minor mobile layout fix for inline code in examples."
pablo: translation timeline: i can turn around fr/de in a day, es in 36h. good to know marketing wants localized bullets for EU social posts.
kevin: merge window? marketing deadline is tomorrow noon CET. we should aim to merge relnotes + migrate doc tonight.
anna: target: merge everything by 22:00 PT. kevin/meI: can you request reviews earlier?
kevin: will ping reviewers in 10m for #3801-#3803.
mei: opened PR #3804 and merged.
docs-bot: PR #3802 opened by kevin  js snippet updates. PR #3803 opened by kevin  go snippet updates.
anna: final ask: include rollback command for operations in relnotes (curl example). kevin, can you draft the exact snippet?
kevin: sure, use this in relnotes:
```
# rollback alias example
curl -X POST \\
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/aliases/switch \\
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \\
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \\
  -d '{"alias":"stable-2026-02"}'
```
anna: perfect. i'll assemble final relnotes, push to staging, and ping here when preview is up. thanks all. last_message_ts=1765010800
